scope: Finite documentation demonstrations; no superiority, population inference or bank effectiveness claim

response.fit: Mean logistic NLL + alpha*(r*L1(slopes)+(1-r)*L2(slopes)^2/2); intercept unpenalized; proximal gradient
response.selection: Mean validation NLL; no regularizer in scoring
response.final: Refit selected configuration on train+validation; score untouched final rows

equilibrium.model: y=x*g_theta(x,a); g is fully trained tanh MLP, Adam, float64, no analytic target in training
equilibrium.selection: Mean validation equilibrium residual squared across two independent initializations
equilibrium.final: Refit on train+validation using fresh seeds; score untouched final states
equilibrium.assessment: Report policy, state derivative, parameter derivative, residual and structural errors; no arbitrary learned-model acceptance threshold

method_settings.random: Public RandomSearcher; replacement allowed and duplicates charged
method_settings.sobol: Public scrambled SobolSearcher; ordinal indices map to physical choices
method_settings.gp: Public GPSearcher; minimize, 4 initial random samples, 2 acquisition restarts, finite domain
method_settings.tpe: Public TPESearcher unchanged Optuna defaults; 10 startup draws, only last 2 of 12 proposals may use density model
method_settings.grid: Exhaustive reference, 15/18 configurations, both tuning seeds; oracle validation minimum never supplied to searchers

numerical_review.response: Independent KKT residual and scalar stable log likelihood from retained coefficients; convex KKT certifies numerical stationarity
numerical_review.equilibrium: Independent NumPy forward and chain-rule derivatives from weights; central differences; exact linear reference solves equations
numerical_review.regret: Best tuning mean minus complete finite-reference minimum with identical data and training seeds; no final-score selection
numerical_review.resume: Fresh objects and Store completed resume for every method/replicate; no additional objective calls or changed model/report bytes
numerical_review.adverse: Perturbed parameters, overlapping roles, altered artifact digest, invalid configuration and false reference regret must be rejected

review: 12 is smaller than both grids and larger than TPE startup; document weak adaptation opportunity without modifying defaults.
Three predetermined replicates and shared training seeds support descriptive comparisons only; no confidence or power claim.
Response fitting is deterministic; two seeds demonstrate workflow repetition, not extra information.
Neural width/depth alter trained layers and parameter count; analytic policy is verification only.
Shock variance is deliberately zero; this does not reproduce stochastic DSGE or posterior sampling.
Report full grid cost and optimizer overhead; tiny tasks can favor enumeration.
Retain raw failures, duplicates, charged work and immutable run directories.
